dialogues.speaker: Big-Footed Dajiao
dialogues.text: Tiger Fish and Zhongyuan Chop Suey, don't remember exactly how much I ate...

dialogues.speaker: Big-Footed Dajiao
dialogues.text: Once I start, there's no stopping me. Work hard, eat hard, right? I got a big appetite.

dialogues.speaker: Big-Footed Dajiao
dialogues.text: Oh yeah, did you know? Tiger fish actually used to be called something similar, but the sound changed over time... A bride I was carrying once told me.

dialogues.speaker: Big-Footed Dajiao
dialogues.text: ...Darn, it's on the tip of my tongue...
